about: SCENARIOS-CRED's credit rows (DC3c): CRED.1's roles table (each source's word, read), CRED.2's merge by id and CRED.18's one order, on ALL and Northern Rooms. Written from the scenario; cratarr-domain's credits tests read it.

merges.case: (a) the files' COMPOSER on every track, no id; MusicBrainz's composer mb:yt on every work: one credit, ar-401
(b) PERFORMER "Kerys Lae (vocals)" on 4 and 9; MusicBrainz's vocal mb:kl; Discogs' "Vocals" dc:kl, A4 and B3 placed on 4 and 9: one credit
(c) MusicBrainz's violin, with "guest", mb:md on 2 and 3, nothing else naming Maëlle Dour: Listed
(d) the files' PRODUCER "Gwen Arzel" on every track, no id; MusicBrainz's release-level producer mb:ga: one credit, Listed (T-CRED-4: the same record's source names the name)
(e) Discogs' "Artwork – Lou Kerjean" dc:lk: its own word, Listed
(f) Northern Rooms: MusicBrainz's mastering "Ólafur Hrafnsson" mb:oh and Discogs' "Olafur Hrafnsson" dc:oh, both held by ar-411: one credit, by ar-411's one name
(g) Northern Rooms: MusicBrainz's producer mb:sv and Discogs' dc:sv, both "Sanne Vos", no artist here, no link: two (T-CRED-5, OQ-CRED-7 (a))
(h) Northern Rooms: the files' ENGINEER "Daniel Berg", no id, two artists here of that name: a name alone (X8)
(h) then with MusicBrainz's engineer mb:db2 on that record: one credit, ar-413

(i) ALL's track artists: 4 and 9 Yann Tiersen with Kerys Lae featuring (the line's " feat. ", MusicBrainz's joinphrase), 7 Yann Tiersen and Ewen Morvan: a featuring credit and an artist credit; Yann Tiersen, a record artist, never under "artist"

(j), CRED.18: (a)-(e) together, with both sources' piano and the mixers the files and MusicBrainz name apart (CRED.7 (f)): the same credits, order and `by` in every order of the sources; both mixers shown; within a role by first track, then name
CRED.24 (p12): Same Boat, Discogs' extraartist "Featuring – Oda Brenn" (dc:ob): Oda Brenn featuring, on every track

CRED.19 (a), a guard: ALL's track 9 COMPOSER "Kerys Lae & Yann Tiersen", no list tag, no source naming the composers: one name-only credit, crediting neither artist (F54: never split on a bare "&"; the split is DC3a's credit_parts)
CRED.19 (d), a guard: PERFORMER "Carlos Niño & Friends (percussion)": one performer credit, percussion, ar-305, the one artist of that whole name; "Friends" never a person
